title: Lucky Millinder's band and Every Tub
summary: Edison names Millinder's sidemen and recalls his arrangement Every Tub upsetting a Baltimore crowd before Basie played.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Made a few, yeah. Well, we had -- Lucky had a good band. He had Charlie Shavers, Billy Kyle, he had Tab Smith in the band, Don Byas --
Oh, Don Byas was in that band?
Yeah, Don Byas. O'Neil Spencer, the drummer, was in that band. And then he got sick and Walter Johnson took his place. And we had Carl Warwick trumpet player.

Yes, playing trumpet then. Oh, Lucky had a band. In fact, we had a -- Basie went on, We played a dance in Baltimore with two bands and I had written an arrangement called 'Every Tub' and before Basie could get on the bandstand, we had upset the crowd. So Basie said, 'Where the hell did these guys come from,' you know.
Then I went back to New York and I joined Basie's band.
